hero.title: What to notice in this run
body: This export is meant for presentation use: it keeps the chronology of the raw workflow log, but foregrounds the task prompt, agent thinking, execution logs, and final answers.
Code and parsed-code execution are still available for credibility, but they are hidden by default so we can focus on what each agent is doing and why.

phase-1.title: Framing note
body: The orchestrator starts by extracting the review protocol and turning it into a concrete multi-step plan before any agent is called.

phase-2.title: Librarian behavior
body: This is the retrieval phase. The important thing to show here is that the librarian broadens the search space first, and only later does the gatekeeper apply strict inclusion criteria.

phase-6.title: Critic nuance
body: This phase is where the system turns extracted study facts into an interpretable synthesis and explicit quality judgment. For a presentation, this is often the best place to pause and explain how the agent goes from evidence to conclusion.
